units.name: Introduction to Media
tips: Consume a wide range of media — film, journalism, social media — and think critically.
Keep a media diary to track how media shapes your own perspective.
Write clearly and concisely; strong writing is the foundation of media work.

units.name: Journalism Practice
tips: Always verify your sources — accuracy is non-negotiable in journalism.
Practice writing news stories under tight time constraints.
Study the inverted pyramid structure and apply it in every story.

units.name: Digital Content Creation
tips: Experiment with different tools and formats to find your voice.
Analyse high-performing content and understand why it works.
Consistency and quality matter more than quantity of posts.

units.name: Film and Screen Studies
tips: Watch films actively — pause, rewind, and analyse scenes closely.
Learn the core terminology: mise-en-scène, montage, and cinematography.
Compare different directors' styles to strengthen your critical analysis.

units.name: Public Relations Strategy
tips: Understand how to craft key messages tailored to different audiences.
Follow current PR campaigns and crisis communications in the news.
Practice writing press releases, pitches, and communication plans.

units.name: Advertising and Persuasion
tips: Study classic and contemporary ad campaigns to understand persuasion techniques.
Learn the AIDA model (Attention, Interest, Desire, Action) deeply.
Practice creating briefs and concept pitches under tight constraints.
